site.name: Olivo
site.heroLead: Italian cooking, a wood-fired oven and panoramic views over the Thames. A place for long dinners and important evenings.
site.metaDescription: Olivo is an Italian restaurant and bar on the Thames in London: handmade pasta, wood-fired pizza, steaks and signature cocktails. Book a table online.

contacts.directions: 5 minutes' walk from Southwark and Blackfriars stations

hoursNote: The kitchen closes one hour before the restaurant.

about.title: An Italian dinner with a view of the city
paragraphs: Olivo started with a simple idea: cook honest Italian food the way it is cooked at home in Tuscany, and serve it somewhere you want to stay a little longer.

Olive trees grow in the dining room, the wood-fired oven is always lit, and the floor-to-ceiling windows look out across the Thames to St Paul's. The bar stays open until the last guest leaves, and our sommelier will find a wine for any dish.
